briefdescription.para: For a lack of a better name, this field holds either.

listitem.para: a delegation to another RefHandle (m_iVar = REF_REF),
an array holding the referent (IndexRefHandle, m_iVar = REF_ARRAY),
a delegation to a frame variable (m_frame != null, m_iVar >= 0), or
null, for m_iVar = REF_REFERENT, in which case the field REFERENT holds the value

detaileddescription.para: What is quite important is that this field must not change while set - this will ensure the correct behavior of a cloneAs operation.
